name: sonar
description: The viewer's sonar, as on the blog: click the scan and a gaussian pulse swells and shrinks around the hit point while a ring runs out at 3 units a second, fading past 5 units, lighting splats toward green (1, 4, 1). One emission, over in 2 seconds.

source.name: World Labs threeviewer effects (sonar.glsl; blog: sonarEffect(time, 1.0, hit)), blog demo parameters
